prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1108; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you understand it is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were when the accident happened.

A: I was driving on the frontage road near the intersection in Pearland, Texas, heading toward the shopping center on the north side.

Q: What were you doing at the moment of impact?

A: I was changing lanes to move into the right lane because I needed to make a turn about a quarter mile up. I checked my mirror, saw nothing, and started to move over.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other vehicle came up on my right side, and we sideswiped each other. I felt a bump and heard a scraping sound. Both of us pulled over onto the shoulder.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My neck and lower back hurt right away. I didn't think much of it at first, but by that evening the pain was worse, and I had trouble turning my head to check blind spots.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They diagnosed a neck strain and a lower back strain and told me to rest and take anti-inflammatories. I've also scheduled a follow-up with my primary care doctor.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some stiffness years ago after lifting something heavy, but it went away and I didn't need treatment.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want to be sure my vehicle damage and medical bills are handled. I'm still having pain, so I'd appreciate hearing what the next steps are.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
